# Canva Developers SDK documentation

How to develop apps with the Canva Developers SDK.

The Canva Developers SDK is one product for building with Canva. Everything you build with it is an app, and each app is built for one or more of three surfaces: inside Canva, on your own platform, or in an AI assistant.

This documentation explains everything you need to know about creating apps, on any surface.

## Choose a surface

## First steps

* To check what you need before you start, see [Prerequisites](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/prerequisites/).
* To start making an app, see [Quickstart](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/quickstart/).
* To learn the concepts that the APIs are built around, see [Canva concepts](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/canva-concepts/).
* If you have any questions, [create a support ticket](https://canva-external.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/2/group/2).

## Previous product names

The Developers SDK brings together three products that used to be documented separately:

| Previously                                                 | Now                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Apps SDK                                                   | The **Apps inside Canva** surface                                                                                       |
| Connect APIs                                               | The **Canva REST APIs**, which you use to build for **Canva for your platform**                                         |
| Canva Model Context Protocol (MCP), used as a product name | The **Canva for AI assistants** surface, which uses the MCP to integrate Canva's design capabilities into AI assistants |

Released versions keep the names they shipped under, so pages such as [Apps SDK v2 Upgrade guide](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/upgrades-and-migrations/v2-migration-guide/) still refer to the Apps SDK.

## Developer community

If you want to chat with other developers, including Canva engineers, and keep up to date with the latest platform announcements, check out our developer community at [community.canva.dev](https://community.canva.dev/latest).

##### Latest (GA)

### Canva for your platform


#### Canva REST API reference

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference.md): The endpoints, parameters, and responses for the Canva REST APIs.

##### Authentication

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/authentication.md): The Canva REST APIs for managing OAuth tokens.
- [Generate access token](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/authentication/generate-access-token.md): Generate access tokens to access the Canva REST APIs.
- [Introspect access token](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/authentication/introspect-access-token.md): Introspect a token to see its validity and properties.
- [Revoke token](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/authentication/revoke-token.md): Revoke a token and its lineage.

##### Analytics

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/analytics.md): The Canva REST APIs for retrieving design analytics.
- [Get design analytics](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/analytics/get-design-analytics.md): Get analytics for a design, including total views and viewers.
- [Get design analytics links](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/analytics/get-design-analytics-links.md): Get analytics for links in a design.
- [Get design analytics page views](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/analytics/get-design-analytics-page-views.md): Get analytics for individual pages in a design.
- [Get design analytics viewers](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/analytics/get-design-analytics-viewers.md): Get information about users who have viewed a design.
- [Get design analytics views over time](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/analytics/get-design-analytics-views-over-time.md): Get the view count for a design over a time period.

##### Assets

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/assets.md): The Canva REST APIs for managing assets.
- [Create asset upload job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/assets/create-asset-upload-job.md): Create an asynchronous job to upload an asset.
- [Get asset upload job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/assets/get-asset-upload-job.md): Get the status and results of an upload asset job.
- [Create asset upload job via URL](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/assets/create-url-asset-upload-job.md): Create an asynchronous job to upload an asset from a URL.
- [Get asset upload job via URL](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/assets/get-url-asset-upload-job.md): Get the status and results of job to upload asset from a URL.
- [Get asset](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/assets/get-asset.md): Get the metadata for an asset in the user's Project.
- [Update asset](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/assets/update-asset.md): Update the metadata for an asset in the users Projects.
- [Delete asset](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/assets/delete-asset.md): Delete an asset from the user's Projects.

##### Autofill

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/autofills.md): The Canva REST APIs for filling brand templates and designs with data.
- [Create design autofill job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/autofills/create-design-autofill-job.md): Create an asynchronous job to autofill a design from a brand template with your input information.
- [Get design autofill job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/autofills/get-design-autofill-job.md): Get the status and results of an autofill job, including the autofilled design.

##### Brand templates

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/brand-templates.md): The Canva REST APIs for working with brand templates.
- [Publish brand template](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/brand-templates/publish-brand-template.md): Publish a design as a brand template.
- [Get brand template](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/brand-templates/get-brand-template.md): Get the metadata for one of the user's brand templates.
- [Get brand template dataset](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/brand-templates/get-brand-template-dataset.md): Check if a brand template has autofillable fields and what type of information the fields accept.
- [List brand templates](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/brand-templates/list-brand-templates.md): List all the user's brand templates.

##### Comments

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments.md): The Canva REST APIs for design comments.
- [Create thread](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments/create-thread.md): Create a new comment thread on a design.
- [Create reply](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments/create-reply.md): Reply to a comment on a design.
- [Get thread](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments/get-thread.md): Get metadata for a comment thread.
- [Get reply](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments/get-reply.md): Get a comment reply.
- [List replies](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments/list-replies.md): List the replies to a comment on a design.
- [Create comment (deprecated)](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments/create-comment.md): Create a new comment on a design.

##### Designs

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/designs.md): The Canva REST APIs for managing designs.
- [Create design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/designs/create-design.md): Create a Canva design.
- [List designs](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/designs/list-designs.md): List all the user's designs.
- [Get design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/designs/get-design.md): Get the metadata for one of the user's designs.
- [Get design pages](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/designs/get-design-pages.md): Get the metadata for pages in a design.
- [Get design export formats](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/designs/get-design-export-formats.md): Get the export formats available for a design.
- [Get design dataset](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/designs/get-design-dataset.md): Check if a design has autofillable fields and what type of information the fields accept.

##### Design imports

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/design-imports.md): The Canva REST APIs for importing designs from other applications into Canva.
- [Create design import job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/design-imports/create-design-import-job.md): Create an asynchronous job to import a design created in another application.
- [Get design import job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/design-imports/get-design-import-job.md): Get the status and results of a design import job, including the imported design.
- [Create image-to-design import job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/design-imports/create-image-to-design-import-job.md)
- [Get image-to-design import job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/design-imports/get-image-to-design-import-job.md)
- [Create URL import job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/design-imports/create-url-import-job.md): Create an asynchronous job to import a design created in another application, using a URL.
- [Get URL import job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/design-imports/get-url-import-job.md): Get the status and results of a URL import job, including the imported design.

##### Exports

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/exports.md): The Canva REST APIs for exporting designs.
- [Create design export job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/exports/create-design-export-job.md): Create an asynchronous job to export a design from Canva.
- [Get design export job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/exports/get-design-export-job.md): Get the status and results of an export job, including link(s) to the downloadable file(s).

##### Folders

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/folders.md): The Canva REST APIs for managing folders.
- [Create folder](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/folders/create-folder.md): Create a new folder in the user's Projects.

- [Update folder](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/folders/update-folder.md): Update a folder's metadata.
- [Delete folder](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/folders/delete-folder.md): Delete a folder.
- [List folder items](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/folders/list-folder-items.md): List the contents of a folder.
- [Move folder item](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/folders/move-folder-item.md): Move an item from one folder to another.

### Canva for AI assistants


#### Tools


##### Discovery

- [search-designs](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/search-designs.md): Find a user's existing designs by keyword.
- [get-design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-design.md): Look up the metadata and access links for one design.
- [get-design-content](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-design-content.md): Read a design's text content for read-only inspection.
- [get-design-pages](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-design-pages.md): List the pages of a multi-page design.
- [resolve-shortlink](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/resolve-shortlink.md): Expand a Canva shortlink into the full design URL it points to.

##### Generation

- [generate-design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/generate-design.md): Create design candidates from a natural-language brief.
- [create-design-from-candidate](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/create-design-from-candidate.md): Turn a chosen candidate into a real, editable design.
- [create-design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/create-design.md): Generate a new, editable design from a written brief.
- [get-create-design-async-job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-create-design-async-job.md): Check the status of a design generation job and get the finished design.
- [separate-image-layers](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/separate-image-layers.md): Turn a flat image into a new design with separately editable layers.
- [get-separate-image-layers-job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-separate-image-layers-job.md): Check the status of a layer separation job and get the new design.

##### Design operations

- [copy-design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/copy-design.md): Duplicate a design, or selected pages of it, into a new design.
- [resize-design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/resize-design.md): Create a copy of a design adapted to a different canvas size.
- [merge-designs](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/merge-designs.md): Combine, reorder, insert, or delete whole pages across designs.
- [import-design-from-url](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/import-design-from-url.md): Turn a publicly hosted file or web page into a new Canva design.

##### Editing

- [start-editing-transaction](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/start-editing-transaction.md): Open an editing session on a design.
- [perform-editing-operations](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/perform-editing-operations.md): Apply one or more edits within an open editing transaction.
- [commit-editing-transaction](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/commit-editing-transaction.md): Save draft edits from an editing transaction to the design.
- [cancel-editing-transaction](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/cancel-editing-transaction.md): Discard the draft edits in an open editing transaction.

##### Images

- [generate-image](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/generate-image.md): Generate a standalone image from a text prompt, or edit reference images.
- [get-generate-image-job](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-generate-image-job.md): Check the status of an image generation job and get the generated image.
- [remove-background](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/remove-background.md): Remove the background from an image, leaving the subject on a transparent backdrop.

##### Brand templates and autofill

- [search-brand-templates](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/search-brand-templates.md): Find or browse the user's Brand Templates.
- [create-brand-template-draft](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/create-brand-template-draft.md): Create an editable draft design from a Brand Template.
- [publish-brand-template](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/publish-brand-template.md): Publish an existing design as a Brand Template.
- [list-brand-kits](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/list-brand-kits.md): List the Brand Kits available to the user.
- [create-design-from-brand-template](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/create-design-from-brand-template.md): Create a new, editable design from a Brand Template.
- [get-brand-template-dataset](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-brand-template-dataset.md): List the autofill data fields defined in a Brand Template.
- [get-design-dataset](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-design-dataset.md): List the data fields that an existing design can be autofilled with.
- [autofill-design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/autofill-design.md): Populate a design's data fields with text, images, videos, or chart data.

##### Folders

- [create-folder](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/create-folder.md): Create a folder in the user's Canva projects.
- [list-folder-items](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/list-folder-items.md): Browse the designs, folders, and images inside a Canva folder.
- [search-folders](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/search-folders.md): Find folders the user owns or that are shared with them.
- [move-item-to-folder](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/move-item-to-folder.md): Move a design, folder, or image into another Canva folder.

##### Comments

- [comment-on-design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/comment-on-design.md): Add a new comment to a design.
- [reply-to-comment](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/reply-to-comment.md): Add a reply to an existing comment thread on a design.
- [list-comments](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/list-comments.md): List the comment threads on a design.
- [list-replies](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/list-replies.md): Read the replies in a comment thread on a design.

##### Assets and export

- [upload-asset-from-url](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/upload-asset-from-url.md): Upload an image or video from a public URL to the user's media library.
- [create-upload-url](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/create-upload-url.md): Get a single-use URL for uploading a file to Canva.
- [get-assets](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-assets.md): Get names, tags, types, and thumbnails for images and videos used in a design.
- [get-export-formats](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/get-export-formats.md): Check which file formats a design can be exported to.
- [export-design](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/export-design.md): Export a design to a downloadable file.

##### Help

- [help](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools/help.md): Answer Canva product questions with content from the Canva Help Center.
- [Rate limits](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/tools.md): See all the available tools, their rate limits, and plan availability for the Canva MCP server.
- [Usage policy](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/usage-policy.md): Guidelines on appropriate and responsible use of Canva’s MCP server.
- [Prohibited use](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/mcp/prohibited-use.md): Understand what uses of Canva's MCP server aren't permitted.

### Reference apps

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/reference-apps.md): Reference apps that show how to connect your own platform to Canva.
- [Nourish](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/reference-apps/nourish.md): Learn how to connect your marketing platform to Canva and automate content creation workflows
- [Realty Commercial](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/reference-apps/realty-commercial.md): Learn how to connect your real estate platform to Canva and automate property marketing workflows

### Feature examples

- [Overview](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples.md): Explore our collection of example apps to learn how to implement common features and patterns in your Canva app.

#### App elements

- [App element children](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/app-element-children.md): Build composite app elements from multiple child elements.
- [App embed elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/app-embed-elements.md): Create embed elements inside app elements.
- [App image elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/app-image-elements.md): Create image elements inside app elements.
- [App shape elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/app-shape-elements.md): Create shape elements inside app elements.
- [App text elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/app-text-elements.md): Create text elements inside app elements.
- [App video elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/app-video-elements.md): Create video elements inside app elements.

#### Assets and media

- [Asset upload](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/asset-upload.md): Upload and manage assets directly into Canva.
- [Digital asset management](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/digital-asset-management.md): Digital asset management system using Canva app components.
- [Fonts](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/fonts.md): Use the fonts picker to apply custom fonts to text elements in designs.
- [Image editing overlay](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/image-editing-overlay.md): Create custom image editing overlays and filters.

#### Fundamentals

- [Authentication](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/authentication.md): Third-party authentication integration for external platforms.
- [Feature support](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/feature-support.md): Feature detection and conditional functionality based on platform support.
- [Fetch](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/fetch.md): Secure communication between apps and servers using the browser's Fetch API.
- [Multi-account authentication](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/multi-account-authentication.md): Multi-account authentication integration for external platforms.
- [Multi-provider authentication](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/multi-provider-authentication.md): Multiple OAuth provider authentication integration for external platforms.

#### Design interaction

- [Autofill](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/autofill.md): Match data fields and autofill the current design using a hardcoded data table.
- [Brand templates](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/brand-templates.md): Choose a brand template, preview its details, and apply it to the current design using a securely verified brand template token.
- [Design audit](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/design-audit.md): Audit design elements for positioning issues and automatically fix elements that are too close to page edges.
- [Design colors](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/design-colors.md): Retrieve and access design colors.
- [Design editing](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/design-editing.md): Edit and modify design properties and content.
- [Design metadata](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/design-metadata.md): Retrieve and access design metadata and properties.
- [Design template metadata](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/design-template-metadata.md): Access and retrieve design template metadata
- [Design token](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/design-token.md): Secure token-based authentication and design access.
- [Export](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/export.md): Export designs in various formats and resolutions.
- [Page addition](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/page-addition.md): Add new pages with pre-populated elements to designs.
- [Page background](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/page-background.md): Set and modify page background colors and images.
- [Positioning elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/positioning-elements.md): Position elements precisely using page dimensions and coordinates.

#### UI

- [Color](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/color.md): Color picker for Brand, Document, and custom colors.
- [Masonry](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/masonry.md): Masonry layout implementation using the App UI Kit.
- [Notification](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/notification.md): Display toast notifications to users.
- [Open external link](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/open-external-link.md): Open external URLs safely from within Canva apps.

#### Intents

- [Content publisher intent](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/content-publisher-intent.md): Content publisher integration for publishing designs to external platforms.
- [Data connector intent](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/data-connector-intent.md): Data connector integration for external data sources.
- [Intent navigation](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/intent-navigation.md): Example app demonstrating navigating from Design Editor intent to the Content Publisher and Data Connector intents in bulk create.
- [Multiple intents](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/implement-multiple-intents.md): Example app demonstrating design editor and content publisher intents together
- [Request data table](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/request-data-table.md): Request a data table from the app's own Data Connector using requestDataTable.
- [URL expander intent](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/url-expander-intent.md): URL expander integration for Canva AI to expand URLs to Canva supported assets.

#### Drag and drop

- [Drag and drop audio](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/drag-and-drop-audio.md): Drag-and-drop functionality for audio elements.
- [Drag and drop embed](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/drag-and-drop-embed.md): Drag-and-drop functionality for embed elements.
- [Drag and drop image](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/drag-and-drop-image.md): Drag-and-drop functionality for image elements.
- [Drag and drop text](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/drag-and-drop-text.md): Demonstrates how to implement drag-and-drop functionality for text elements with configurable styling properties.
- [Drag and drop video](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/drag-and-drop-video.md): Drag-and-drop functionality for video elements.

#### Design elements

- [Embed elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/embed-elements.md): Add interactive embed elements to designs.
- [Group elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/group-elements.md): Group multiple elements together for unified manipulation.
- [Image elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/image-elements.md): Add image elements to designs with editing capabilities.
- [Richtext elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/richtext-elements.md): Add rich text elements with formatting to designs.
- [Shape elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/shape-elements.md): Add geometric shape elements to designs.
- [Shape elements with asset](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/shape-elements-with-asset.md): Create shape elements with image and video fills.
- [Table elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/table-elements.md): Add structured table elements with rows and columns.
- [Text elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/text-elements.md): Create and style text elements in designs.
- [Video elements](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/video-elements.md): Add video elements to designs with playback controls.

#### Localization

- [I18n](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/i18n.md): Internationalization support using react-intl with ICU syntax implementation.

#### Content replacement

- [Image replacement](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/image-replacement.md): Replace selected image elements with custom images.
- [Richtext replacement](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/richtext-replacement.md): Replace selected rich text elements with formatted content.
- [Text replacement](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/text-replacement.md): Replace selected text elements with custom content.
- [Text translation](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/text-translation.md): Replace and translate text elements across different languages.
- [Video replacement](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/video-replacement.md): Replace selected video elements in designs with custom content.

#### Testing

- [UI test](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/ui-test.md): UI and snapshot testing App UI.
- [Unit test](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/feature-examples/unit-test.md): Unit testing Apps SDK packages.
